aiVideo.note: AI video is a fallback for art/mood shots whose reproduction is too hard; never for evidence, real people, data or readable type. A generated video is not a real asset.

note: Generated stills are lookdev/reference only. A final frame/video must be built from 3D, real footage, procedural graphics, or live type — never a generated still used as the shot.
